newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK to ease travel restrictions for Macau residents.
newsitem.headline: HK to ease travel restrictions for Macau residents.

text.p: Hong Kong's immigration department said on Monday it would relax visa restrictions for residents of neighbouring Macau with effect from April 1.

The Immigration Department said in a statement that visa-free entry for seven days would be granted to holders of Portuguese Aliens passports and to those who have resided Macau for at least two years.
Only 110,000 of Macau's 454,000 residents hold full Portuguese passports. They are permitted a three month stay in Hong Kong.
Holders of Portuguese Aliens passports are mostly immigrants from China.
The statement also said the length of stay granted to Macau Visit Permit holders would be extended to 14 days from seven days a month.
Macau reverts to Chinese rule in December 1999, two and a half years after the British colony of Hong Kong is handed over to China.
